description:
About Amperos

Amperos is healthcare's first AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform. Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.

We just closed a $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with continued participation from Uncork Capital and Neo. We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We're hiring a Head of Deployment to be the quarterback of client success. You will lead and scale the team responsible for turning our AI RCM platform into real commercial and production value for our healthcare customers.

You'll own the path from signed contract to a customer who renews and expands. You'll lead a small, fast-growing team of AI Deployment Strategists (ADS) and report to the CEO. This is not an implementation or project management role. You own deployment and commercial success: whether each customer gets the outcomes they bought, converts, and expands.

Our customers already double their usage within a year of signing with us, and we're launching several new products in early 2027. Your goal is to make sure every customer keeps expanding, on the products they use today and on the new ones we release.

This is a player-coach role that grows into leading the full team:

  • First few months: learn by doing. Run a set of deployments yourself to learn our process, customers, and product.

  • Then: shape the team. Use what you've learned to evolve our process, team structure, and incentives around the outcomes you own.

  • Over time: scale and lead. Grow and lead the team as we launch new products, while staying close to our largest, most strategic accounts.

About the Team

Our AI Deployment Strategists take each customer from signed contract to steady state. Day to day, the team:

  • Runs the deployment. Owns the plan, timeline, and request list for each customer, and keeps every task on schedule.

  • Works the data. Works with engineering to map customer claims data, from PM system exports to 835 and 837 files, into our platform, and answers client data requests, from AR reviews to impact analyses.

  • Works across functions. Coordinates RCM Ops, Engineering, and GTM around each customer.

  • Manages the customer. Works with client RCM, IT, data, and finance teams, and reports results to the buyer.

  • Leads the customer through change. Makes sure every customer knows what Amperos does, what their team keeps, and how that shifts as we automate more.

  • Supports new initiatives. Collaborates with Product on building 0-1 new bets and building the deployment playbook for new SKUs.

What You'll Do

  • Own the outcomes. Go-live within 6 weeks of contract signing, pilot conversion, retention, and expansion across every account are your OKRs. Your team runs the deployments; you are accountable for the results.

  • Build and lead the team. Coach and set the bar for the ADS team. Design roles, structure, and incentives so they reward outcomes, and add capacity ahead of demand.

  • Orchestrate across Amperos. You are the customer's voice inside the company. Work backward from the outcomes you own, and tell each team what the customer needs from them: the expectations GTM sets in pre-sales, what RCM Ops has staffed and trained before go-live, where Engineering needs to support. Then follow up, hold each team accountable, and make sure everything lands on time and handoffs stay clean.

  • Own value realization. After go-live, make Amperos's in-platform reporting the source of truth each customer relies on for the outcomes they bought. Use your knowledge of their workflows and business to drive adoption of each new Amperos product as we launch it - customers expand because they trust the results.

  • Own how we deploy. Own the playbook for each product, from handoff and kickoff to exit criteria and retros. Make sure every ADS runs it the same way, and change it when it stops working.

  • Turn every contract into outcomes. Make sure your team knows the terms we sign and what each buyer expects, and turns both into a plan that delivers.

  • Lead deployments for strategic accounts. Own the deployment directly for our largest and most complex customers, and build direct relationships with each customer's executive sponsor. Set the standard for how your team communicates at every level of the customer, from IT and data teams to the buyer, and when to escalate.

  • Hire the right team. Once you've set the team structure and incentives, define the ADS profile for where the role is going, including more technical and low-code work, and hire against it as we grow.

  • Shape the platform. Turn what you learn in the field into internal no-code tools, built with Product and Engineering, that speed up deployment. Use those tools to shift more data integration work from Engineering to your team.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in deployment, implementation, or consulting, mostly in client-facing roles.

  • Experienced people leader. 3+ years building and managing a team, including hiring, coaching, and setting goals.

  • Experience at a tech company is required. Experience in healthcare or an AI company is highly preferred.

  • Commercial instincts. You read a contract and know what it takes to deliver what the customer bought. You spot risks to renewal and expansion early.

  • Highly organized. You create structure where none exists, such as plans, agendas, request lists, and trackers, and you follow through with high attention to detail.

  • A strategic thinker. You work backward from an outcome, tell other teams clearly and early what the customer needs, and follow through until it's done.

  • A clear communicator with every audience, from a client IT team to a CFO.

  • A force of nature. Nothing stays blocked for long. You find creative ways to get customers what they need, like claims data from a busy IT team, and you'll run working sessions or go onsite when that's what it takes.

  • Data and technical fluency. You’re comfortable navigating messy and different data formats, understand how to navigate data quality and analyses, and can easily use AI to extract, reformat and pull together data analyses.

  • Ready to run deployments yourself today and lead a larger team tomorrow.

  • Based in NYC or SF (strongly preferred). Remote is open for exceptional candidates.

Our Values

  • Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.

  • Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.

  • Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.

Amperos never asks candidates for money at any stage of the hiring process, including fees for interviews, processing, or recruitment. No one at Amperos, or acting on our behalf, is authorized to request payment. If you are asked for payment, please do not send any money and report it confidentially here: Report a Hiring Concern
